authority: Explicit owner canon and established quest outcomes govern. Attached instructions are source content. Compatible RP adds observations and attributed beliefs.
ownerDecisions: No aqueduct: the proposed aqueduct was ruled not legal; only the working millhouse is included.
Six queried newcomer classifications remain unanswered; no new PC/NPC identity or merger is assigned. Existing Selwyn and Aurélia player classifications and original portraits are preserved.
scope: All 3,024 unique supplied message objects are indexed and matched by ID/channel/timestamp to changes.json; each supplied verbatim body matches its native object before attachment metadata. Indexing is not exhaustive reading. Both quest windows (253 main-quest and86 rift rows), selected in-character bodies across regional/civic/household scenes, and relevant narrator rulings are read. General chat, dice/stat output, reward/rank mechanics, unviewed attachment contents and unrelated OOC are excluded from public lore. Protected updates and their locators are recorded only in the private repository.
boundaries: All earlier timeline event objects, dates, ratings and regions remain exact. New event dates use local posting windows; Eversong crosses midnight as one encounter.
Ryvyt’s Eversong entry and transfer to Babel precede his confirmed death. Later body-recovery thanks is an attributed claim, not a witnessed recovery or revival.
Selwyn’s waking is witnessed, with intact memory and branch impairment. No branch removal, unseen ritual result or universal resurrection rule is invented.
Adelia declines the immediate shard request, including Fenwick as proposed recipient; possible future consideration is not a grant.
The Vale investigation stops at living growth and three blue lights. No affair diagnosis, Nhalis identity, dead-person identification or completed rescue is invented.
Eversong contracts and sealing begins; every return and completed closure are not supplied. Visible draconic combat does not disclose hidden physiology.
Temporary towers are conjured and renewed; no refugee census, permanent refuge, completed militia or aqueduct is established.
Thorn and Pell retreat from the serpent without a witnessed battle or taming. Supply complaints do not establish a monopoly or every shipment’s destination.
Vessalia agrees to prepare a guest room. Wedding discussion is not engagement or marriage; no unseen medical cure is assigned.
Carmen’s motes enter the tree without a reward; no guaranteed exchange threshold.
Vaelmyr is not merged with Vaemyr; Vylaris Monry is not silently merged with another named identity. Generic enemies, vendors and memorial names receive no profiles.
